answer: One agent passes one annual vehicle inspection and ties the certificate number to a single identity. A ledge of fake identities needs a meadow of paperwork: three established peers check the certificate in the public transport registry, the inspection report, and a fresh signature. Inspection costs $20 to $80 plus the vehicle itself, so a thousand fakes burns $20,000 to $80,000 and a thousand vehicles, each one waiting on a separate garage visit. The certificate expires yearly, or the record lapses. Like quartz in stone, one inspection ties one agent to one record no one else can claim.
